metadata.description: Validated longevity protein targets with crystal structures and quantum simulation parameters
metadata.evidence_standard: Minimum Phase 1 clinical trial or >50 citations in IF>10 journal

nad_sirtuins.description: NAD+ biosynthesis and sirtuin-mediated deacetylation — mitochondrial energy and DNA repair
nad_sirtuins.biological_rationale: NAD+ declines 50% by age 60. Sirtuins (SIRT1-7) require NAD+ as cofactor for deacetylation of histones, p53, PGC-1α. Boosting NAD+ restores mitochondrial function and DNA repair capacity.

targets.name: NAMPT
targets.function: Rate-limiting enzyme in NAD+ salvage pathway
targets.quantum_rationale: NAD+ biosynthesis involves phosphoribosyl transfer — charge redistribution across multiple atoms requires multi-reference treatment
targets.classical_fails_because: Phosphoribosyl transfer TS has significant multi-reference character (T1 diagnostic > 0.02)

targets.name: SIRT1
targets.function: Deacetylates histones H3/H4, p53, PGC-1α using NAD+ as cofactor
targets.quantum_rationale: Contains catalytic Zn²⁺ center with 4 coordinating cysteines — d-electron correlation cannot be captured by single-reference DFT
targets.classical_fails_because: Zn²⁺-thiolate coordination has near-degenerate d-orbitals; DFT underestimates Zn-S bond energies by 5-8 kcal/mol

targets.name: SIRT3
targets.function: Mitochondrial deacetylase — SOD2 activation, fatty acid oxidation
targets.quantum_rationale: Same Zn²⁺ catalytic mechanism as SIRT1; mitochondrial-specific isoform

senolytics.description: Selective elimination of senescent cells that secrete SASP inflammatory factors
senolytics.biological_rationale: Senescent cells accumulate with age, secrete IL-6, IL-8, MMPs (SASP). Clearing them with senolytics extends healthspan 36% in mice (Baker et al., Nature 2016). BCL-2 family anti-apoptotic proteins keep zombie cells alive.

targets.name: BCL-xL
targets.function: Prevents apoptosis by sequestering pro-apoptotic BAX/BAK
targets.quantum_rationale: Navitoclax binding involves extensive π-stacking in BH3 groove — dispersion interactions poorly captured by DFT
targets.classical_fails_because: π-π stacking energies have 2-4 kcal/mol DFT errors; MP2 overestimates. Need CCSD-level correlation.

targets.name: BCL-2
targets.function: Master anti-apoptotic protein in senescent cells
targets.quantum_rationale: Similar BH3 groove π-stacking mechanism as BCL-xL

telomerase.description: Telomere maintenance via telomerase reverse transcriptase activation
telomerase.biological_rationale: Telomeres shorten ~50-100 bp per cell division. When critically short, cells senesce or apoptose. Telomerase (hTERT + hTR) can elongate telomeres. Most somatic cells don't express hTERT. Activating it transiently could rejuvenate cells without cancer risk if controlled.
key_papers: Bernardes de Jesus et al., EMBO Mol Med 2012 (DOI: 10.1002/emmm.201200245)

targets.name: hTERT
targets.function: Catalytic subunit of telomerase — adds TTAGGG repeats to telomere ends
targets.quantum_rationale: Active site contains Mg²⁺ coordinated with two aspartates and the incoming dNTP — classic two-metal-ion mechanism requiring multi-reference treatment
targets.classical_fails_because: Two-metal-ion polymerase mechanism has strong static correlation between Mg-O bonds; DFT barrier heights off by 3-5 kcal/mol

rapalogs_mtor.description: mTOR inhibition to mimic caloric restriction and activate autophagy
rapalogs_mtor.biological_rationale: mTOR (mechanistic target of rapamycin) integrates nutrient signals. Chronic activation accelerates aging. Low-dose rapamycin extends lifespan 15-25% in mice (Harrison et al., Nature 2009). Intermittent dosing preserves immune function.
key_papers: Mannick et al., Sci Transl Med 2018 (DOI: 10.1126/scitranslmed.aaq1564)

targets.name: mTOR-FKBP12
targets.function: Rapamycin binds FKBP12 first, then the complex inhibits mTOR kinase
targets.quantum_rationale: Rapamycin-FKBP12 interface involves macrolide conformational flexibility + multiple H-bonds in unusual geometry
targets.classical_fails_because: Macrolide ring strain + intramolecular H-bond network has conformational correlation effects missed by DFT

targets.name: AMPK
targets.function: Cellular energy sensor — activates autophagy, inhibits mTOR when ATP low
targets.quantum_rationale: AMP/ATP binding site discrimination involves subtle phosphate charge delocalization
targets.classical_fails_because: Polyphosphate charge delocalization + Mg²⁺ coordination is multi-reference
